about: The intended differences between the skins' components (scripts/api-snapshot.mjs fails on any other): a component, a parameter or a default only one skin has, each with its reason. A skin switch is one line because everything else is the same.

components.@tsazor/bootstrap:Modal: Bootstrap's name for the Dialog (an alias, D-C3)
components.@tsazor/fluent:FluentForm: Fluent UI Blazor's name for the Form (Form is an alias of it)
components.@tsazor/fluent:FluentProvider: the theme root of Fluent's design tokens; Bootstrap themes with data-bs-theme
components.@tsazor/fluent:Indicator: Fluent's status dot; Bootstrap has no counterpart
components.@tsazor/fluent:Spacer: Fluent UI Blazor's FluentSpacer; Bootstrap spaces with its utilities

parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:Badge.pill: Bootstrap's rounded-pill badge; Fluent's badges are round already
parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:Checkbox.switch: Bootstrap draws a switch as a checkbox (form-switch); Fluent has the Switch component
parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:Dialog.centered: Bootstrap's modal-dialog-centered; Fluent centers every dialog
parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:Progress.striped: Bootstrap's progress-bar-striped; Fluent's bar has no stripes
parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:Spinner.intent: Bootstrap's colored spinners; Fluent's spinner is the brand color
parameters.@tsazor/bootstrap:ButtonGroup.size: Bootstrap's btn-group-sm/-lg; in Fluent each Button takes its size
parameters.@tsazor/fluent:Badge.appearance: Fluent's filled, tint, outline and ghost badges; Bootstrap has one look
parameters.@tsazor/fluent:Badge.size: Fluent's badge sizes; Bootstrap's badge follows the text around it
parameters.@tsazor/fluent:Card.appearance: Fluent's filled card; Bootstrap's card has one look
